Monologue: Pardon my intrusion, friend, but won't you mind waiting a little longer before closing?
We have much to speak of. Would be a shame to delay our inevitable meeting any longer.
I understand you are not much of a socialite, so I'll ask my questions and be on my way.
Are you fond of your new friends?
The ones who keep coming back. Desperate. Harboring some small hope that your diner could inject meaning back into their lives.
This city, my friend, is one big, bright, beautiful fire. A tragedy long-past the point of saving, yet the insects can't help but be drawn to it.
Hold your companions close, friend. Even the great Daedalus could not save his own son.
A simple warning may not be enough…
